post_correction.method: Post-hoc replacement of 18 original money trials by 18 explicit-contract trials. Original raw series preserved.

remaining_failure.issue: Private grader requires rejecting unknown envelope fields; the prompt explicitly rejects unknown row fields but does not explicitly reject unknown envelope fields.

scope: isolated terminal only; functional acceptance; no blinded manual code quality score
interpretation: All revised money trials pass the same private checks. This supports the contract-ambiguity explanation within this dataset, without proving universal model equivalence or causal attribution from three repetitions.
